 WEEKDAYS = {name: number for number, name in enumerate("SUN MON TUE WED THU FRI SAT".split())}
 
 
+def _parse_value(token: str, names: Mapping[str, int] | None) -> int:
+    if token == "":
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid value {token!r}")
+    if names:
+        value = names.get(token.upper())
+        if value is not None:
+            return value
+    if not token.isdigit():
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid value {token!r}")
+    return int(token)
+
+
+def _check_range(a: int, b: int, lo: int, hi: int) -> None:
+    if a > b:
+        raise ValueError(f"range {a}-{b} wraps around")
+    if not (lo <= a <= hi) or not (lo <= b <= hi):
+        raise ValueError(f"range {a}-{b} out of bounds {lo}..{hi}")
+
+
+def _expand_item(item: str, lo: int, hi: int, names: Mapping[str, int] | None) -> list[int]:
+    step = 1
+    if "/" in item:
+        base, step_token = item.split("/", 1)
+        if "/" in step_token or base == "":
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid item {item!r}")
+        step = _parse_value(step_token, names)
+        if step < 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"step {step} must be at least 1")
+        if base == "*":
+            return list(range(lo, hi + 1, step))
+        if "-" in base:
+            a_token, b_token = base.split("-", 1)
+            if "-" in b_token:
+                raise ValueError(f"invalid item {item!r}")
+            a = _parse_value(a_token, names)
